name: Lhurgoyf
description: A beast that avenges its stolen eggs and is given a hunter's conscience and speech.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lhurgoyfs spread across Dominaria during the Ice Age, adapting to a carrion diet, and later migrate north to the Northland.
timeline.quote: Lhurgoyfs spread across Dominaria during the Ice Age

citation.text: "Lhurgoyf", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At least one lhurgoyf is found in Urborg by the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: at least one lhurgoyf was to be found in Urborg

citation.text: "Lhurgoyf", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter's last words warn Hans to run from the Lhurgoyf.
timeline.quote: Ach! Hans, run! It's the Lhurgoyf!

citation.text: Lhurgoyf (Oversized League Prizes, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A lhurgoyf kills and eats Saffi while hunting the poachers who stole its eggs.
timeline.quote: kills and eats Saffi, while Hans flees back to their town for protection.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Ach! Hans, Run! , by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard transfers Fedor's sapience into the lhurgoyf, which vows to protect Balduvia's people while Fedor becomes feral.
timeline.quote: The lhurgoyf vows to protect the people of Balduvia to make amends for those it killed before.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Ach! Hans, Run! , by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
